Game Overview

Bumpy Ball is a ball title where guide a bouncing ball through vibrant landscapes, smashing into matching colors while avoiding mismatches. With intuitive tap controls and escalating speed, challenge your reflexes and precision in this fast-paced arcade adventure. Survive as long as possible to achieve the highest score in this exhilarating, addictive game!
